_comment: Tier-2: verifies febio::heat#0 — an unregistered <Module type=...> value is not diagnosed, it SEGFAULTS. FEBioModuleSection.cpp hands the string to FEModelBuilder::SetActiveModule() with no existence check. Runs four bad module strings ('heat' and 'biphasic-FSI', both of which OASiS templates used and neither of which exists in FEBio 4.12, plus the pure case errors 'Solid' and 'SOLID') and one positive control ('solid'). Verified 2026-08-03 on FEBio 4.12.0.86045466d: all four exit with SIGSEGV, no ERROR box, no FAILED! line, no .log file; the positive control reads SUCCESS. The positive control is what makes the four crashes attributable to the module string. Skips cleanly when no febio4 binary is installed.
